wu: Simon Says: Teacher calls out 'Simon says touch your head/shoulders/knees/arms/hands/feet/eyes/ears'. Students touch the correct body part. Teacher says 'My head hurts' and pretends to hold it, students repeat.
wuAlt: Body Part Bingo: Teacher shows flashcards, students shout 'Bingo!' when they have 3 in a row on their grid.
Action Charades: Student mimes a body part, others guess 'It is your ___!'.
pres: Teacher holds flashcards of body parts, says 'This is my head' and points to own head, students repeat. Teacher draws a sad face on the board, points to head, says 'My head hurts', students repeat. Teacher asks 'What is it? It is a ___.' for each flashcard.
presAlt: Storytime: Read 'My Body' book, point to each body part and say the word. Students repeat.
TPR Drill: Teacher does actions (touch head, clap hands) and says the word, students copy.
prac: Picture Dictation: Student A has a picture of a monster, Student B has a blank paper. Student A says 'Draw a big head', Student B draws. They swap roles using target body parts.
pracAlt: Memory Game: Flashcards are face down. Students take turns turning two over, saying 'It is a ___' if they match.
Body Part Relay: Teams race to touch body parts on flashcards pinned to the wall.
ls: Listen and Draw: Teacher says 'Draw a circle for the head. Draw two circles for the eyes. Draw a circle for the stomach.' Students draw and label. Teacher checks each drawing.
re: Musical Body Parts: Play music, students dance. When music stops, teacher shouts a body part, students must touch it. Last one out is 'it'.
prod: Doctor Roleplay: Students work in pairs. One is the doctor, one is the patient. Patient says 'My ___ hurts', Doctor says 'Touch your ___'. They swap roles.
rw: Label the Monster: Students trace body part words (head, shoulders, etc.) from the board onto a monster poster. Then they copy 4 words into their notebook.
st: Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes song: Sing slowly, then faster. End with 'Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line'.
g: Teacher calls out body parts, students touch them if 'Simon says'.
Students mark off body parts on their bingo cards as teacher calls them.
Students touch body parts when music stops.
Patient says 'My ___ hurts', Doctor says 'Touch your ___'.
Students trace and copy body words onto a poster.
diff: Fast finishers: Draw a monster with 8 body parts and label them all.
Support: Use word bank with pictures for labeling activity.
hw: Read your 'My Body' mini-book to someone at home and point to the body parts.
Ask 3 family members 'What is your favourite body part?' and write their answers.
Play 'Simon Says' with a brother or sister.
tip: Use exaggerated facial expressions when demonstrating 'My ___ hurts' to convey meaning without translation. Connect to local culture by discussing how to say 'I have a headache' in Darija.
